source.title: Federal Reserve Bulletin, July 1930 — Foreign Exchange Rates
source.institution: Federal Reserve Board; digitised by Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRASER
source.bodyLocator: Printed page450, FOREIGN EXCHANGE RATES, Country / Monetary unit columns and complete numbered footnotes; OCR page block ends before printed451 PRICE MOVEMENTS.
source.reviewRoute: Full official FRASER OCR body read, including entire page450 table and footnotes. Not merely search snippets. Original PDFpage59 (printed450) rendered locally and independently visually inspected both columns and complete notes.
source.cacheFailure: Initial fulltext HTML acquisition failed; subsequent verified /files/docs/ original PDF acquisition succeeded. Failure retained as acquisition history, not current evidence limitation.
source.reuseSearch: Existing source registry and retained research filename catalogue searched first; no reusable FRASER1930 body or registered exchange-table source found. Existing monetary evidence remains reusable for independent corroboration.

transcriptionMethod: Single original page visually reviewed; country/unit cells manually transcribed as factual source data. Raw source spelling and ditto cells retained. No numerical rate parsing or historical-entity corpus.
